snippet.title: Perpetuo Trailer #2
snippet.description:
Get it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3445500/Perpetuo/
Press Kit: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/13oXH0vPxfh6EXjgsyis-oerAKRytTgnN?usp=drive_link

Perpetuo is a first-person psychological horror game about an apartment that refuses to let you go. Each time you wake up there, the place has changed: furniture shifts, doors disappear, new rooms bleed through the walls. The building remembers more than you do… and it is not done with you yet.

The apartment knows how many times you have been here.

…are you sure this is your first time?
